Principal Machine Learning Engineer

Seattle, WA, USA · Remote (United States) Req ID: R-2026-04-118

About Stratford Industries

Stratford Industries is a Fortune-200 manufacturer with operations in 27 countries and over 38,000 employees. Our R&D division operates four advanced research labs developing materials, robotics, and ML systems for industrial automation.

Role overview

The Stratford R&D AI lab is hiring a Principal Machine Learning Engineer to lead a team of 9 researchers and engineers building computer-vision systems for our manufacturing-defect detection platform. You'll be responsible for the technical strategy, hiring, and mentorship for the team.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead technical strategy for the manufacturing-defect detection platform
  • Architect production ML systems serving 200M+ images/day
  • Hire, mentor, and grow a team of 9 ML engineers and researchers
  • Partner with R&D leadership on roadmap and external academic collaborations
  • Author and present at top-tier ML/CV conferences (CVPR, NeurIPS, ICML)

Required qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional machine learning or research experience
  • PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or related field, or equivalent industry experience
  • Strong publication record at top-tier venues (CVPR, NeurIPS, ICML, ECCV)
  • Production experience deploying ML systems at scale (millions of inference req/day)
  • Deep expertise in PyTorch and modern computer-vision architectures
  • Track record of mentoring senior researchers and engineers
  • Experience with distributed training (multi-GPU, multi-node)

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in industrial computer vision, defect detection, or manufacturing
  • Familiarity with edge inference (TensorRT, ONNX, OpenVINO)
  • Open-source contributions to PyTorch ecosystem
  • Experience with model compression, quantization, or distillation
  • Background in physics-informed ML or simulation-augmented training

Compensation and authorization

Base salary range: $290,000 - $360,000 USD, depending on location, level, and experience, plus equity (RSU) and annual bonus. Stratford Industries provides comprehensive benefits and will sponsor work authorization for qualified candidates.
